title: Specialist I - User Research Design Strategist
description:
**Role Description**
**As a Specialist I - UX Design,**
you will be challenged to drive through complex and ambiguous scenarios of transformational projects and initiatives. We expect you to be a strategic thinker with an ability to collaborate, create and articulate your thoughts and frameworks that pave way for experiences to be built upon.
  
  
**Responsibilities Product/Service Innovation**

* Observe and study the paradigm shifts happening at the intersection of cultural, social, economic, political, technological, and market forces
* Device methodologies to discern the future and map the emerging landscape with scenario planning and plausible narratives on potential futures
* Work towards identifying the core problem areas and arriving to creative briefs in ambiguous situations, especially with large-scale businesses
* Uncover uncharted needs through deep-dives to plan and create strategic point of views encapsulating consumer insights, business success metrics and potential design interventions
* Create experience/ecosystem maps, develop insights, experience/service journeys and blueprints, interaction models, process flows and storyboards Business Initiatives & Engagement
* Co-create and help business units to develop product/service definition for non-existent offerings
* Engage deeply with stakeholders/target users to observe and analyze systems, barriers and challenges of the existing product/service
* Play an active role in new business initiatives and collaborate with a cross-disciplinary teams to identify and dive deep into a potential opportunities
* Innovation Workshops: plan, design, strategize, and synthesize, conduct interviews, and creative brainstorms that often involves C-suite execs, business leaders and tech/marketing leads
* Participate in deep dives and experience reviews with cross-functional teams and drive design decisions Design Leadership
* Drive/contribute towards initiatives for advancing and improvising internal creative processes
* Overview creative aspects of on-going engagements, review scope, and guide design teams, especially during initial phases
* Study and experiment new creative methods that support our expression
* Inspire and mentor designers

**Requirements**

* Masters/Bachelors degree in Strategic Design Management or related design discipline
* 7+ years of industry experience - An online portfolio with latest projects showcasing abilities across a wide range of platforms. Share password if protected or be willing to showcase the work during the interview
* Must have a strong point of view towards user-centered design methods and knowledge of innovation strategies, frameworks and design thinking approaches
* Skills to produce output whenever required using relevant design softwares.
* Experience working in a start-up or fast-paced environment is a plus

**Skills**
User Research, Design Thinking, Corporate Strategy, Stakeholder Management, Requirements Gathering, Process Documentation, Workshop Facilitation

title: Analyst - User Research
description:
**Senior Analyst - User Research - IN**
The role will be required to get an understanding of users' needs, goals and pain points with a particular product or service. Study and analyze customer feedback received through quantitative/qualitative surveys and provide appropriate actionable insights to help the respective product teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities And Duties**

* Define goals, scope, and plan a research based on the business/product/design requirements and conduct appropriate research (moderated/unmoderated) research in the given timeline.
* Provide support to other researchers and studies to analyze the users’ data, derive insights, and define opportunity areas.
* Chose the right research methodology regarding research study and create a continuous research practice within the team and process to deliver regular user research reports.

**Educational Requirements**

* University (Degree) Preferred

**Work Experience**

* No Experience Required

**Physical Requirements**

* Physical Requirements: Sedentary Work

**Career Level**
5IC
  
  
Related Skills
  
  
Analytical Skills, Audience-focused Communication, Collaboration, Communication, Content Development, Copywriting, Data-Based Decision Making, Detail-Oriented, Econometrics, Economic Analysis, Financial Forecasting, Financial Modeling, Market/Industry Dynamics, Prioritizes Effectively, Problem Solving, Research Synthesization, Statistics
